title: Freeport-McMoRan Form 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: The filing reports USD 9.4 billion consolidated debt, USD 4.1 billion cash and USD 2.1 billion net debt excluding USD 3.2 billion of PTFI downstream debt.
summary: The August 6 Form 10-Q confirms the Q2 exhibit economics, balance sheet, Grasberg recovery schedule, 2026 sales, cost, cash-flow and capital-spending outlook, IUPK application and export-proceeds uncertainty; it adds no evidence that supports the market rerating.
